name: Koldunic Sorcery — 3 Advanced — Lord of the Land

system.description:
Available to only a few ancient Fiends, this power lets the Tzimisce mystically tap into the spirits of the land, effectively becoming one with the realm. The vampire metamorphoses into something less like a vampire and more like a guardian spirit, knowing most of what transpires within her domain and gaining a measure of control over the land itself.

System: Always active once acquired. The Tzimisce chooses a fiefdom on which the power centers, including her haven, no more than a 10-mile radius. Within that area she is lord and master: the difficulty of her own Dominate, Presence, Animalism, and Koldunic Sorcery powers against natives of the fiefdom is reduced; she may subtly control weather and climate, shift landmarks to mislead or trap travelers, and pinpoint the location of intruders anywhere within the fiefdom. The power carries a heavy cost: the Tzimisce becomes bound to the fiefdom and will never willingly leave it. If forced out, she suffers as though cut off from her ancestral soil, and if her Dice Pools are reduced to a single die across the board, she withers and dies.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: Permanent while bound to the fiefdom
